authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9758.2 *matsiya explicitly gives Kalasha macī fish, including Urtsoon ū-macī. Survey matshī/mūtsī forms are compared with that extended fish family; aspiration and the rounded vowel are retained as regional phonetic qualifications. Exact survey form maʦhī is preserved.
